description: Header file defining the AudioBiquadFilter class for implementing a biquad filter in Android's audio framework. It includes class declarations, constants, state management, and method signatures for configuring, processing, and transitioning filter states.

classes.name: AudioBiquadFilter
classes.description: Class implementing a biquad filter with support for multiple channels, smooth coefficient transitions, and enable/disable functionality.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Reconfigures the filter with new channel count and sample rate.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets internal state and coefficients to identity.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears delay lines without resetting coefficients.

methods.name: setCoefs
methods.description: Sets new filter coefficients, optionally transitioning smoothly.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes a buffer of multi-channel audio samples.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables the filter, with optional smooth transition.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables the filter, with optional smooth transition.
